name: diff-shepherd
description: A non-intrusive, batch-review interface for Claude Code changes

claude.name: Diff Shepherd
claude.description: Batch code review without breaking flow. Watch for file changes in a side panel and accept/reject in bulk.

tools.name: start_diff_shepherd
tools.description: Start Diff Shepherd to review code changes in a non-intrusive side panel

directory.description: Directory to watch for changes (default: current working directory)

tools.name: set_focus_file
tools.description: Set the file the user is currently editing for context-aware highlighting

filePath.description: Path to the file the user is currently editing

tools.name: clear_focus_file
tools.description: Clear the manual focus file and enable auto-detection
